red_corridor.speaker: Her
red_corridor.line_1: Chorus, body at the foot of the slope. Armor split open. Three symbiotes are still moving under the ribs.
red_corridor.line_2: One bond is possible. The shock will kill the others and make the survivor dependent on me.

red_corridor.speaker: Her
red_corridor.line_1: A failed egg lies against the wall, thin as wet paper. Something inside taps once, then goes still.
red_corridor.line_2: Shell residue gives quiet biomass. Drag marks lead to more biomass and danger. Leaving keeps me moving and loses the read.

red_corridor.speaker: Her
red_corridor.line_1: The left wall swells between two ribs. A narrow seam opens, breathing warm air that smells like copper and spoiled milk.
red_corridor.line_2: Cutting the seam gives biomass and marks me. Listening may lower danger. Leaving it closed gives up the biomass.

red_corridor.speaker: Her
red_corridor.line_1: Boot prints press into the membrane, heel and toe still visible. Dried blood flakes at the edges.
red_corridor.line_2: Chorus, someone walked this route before me. I mark the stride and keep moving.

red_corridor.speaker: Her
red_corridor.line_1: Buzzing rolls down the corridor. A blood hunter crawls out of a ceiling slit, swollen abdomen dragging on the floor.
red_corridor.line_2: Fighting can earn biomass. Slipping past avoids injury now and raises danger later.

red_corridor.speaker: Her
red_corridor.line_1: The corridor narrows to a dry red tube. No sacs, no tracks, only slow heat through the floor.
red_corridor.line_2: Nothing blocks me here. I keep my pace and save my blood.

amber_corridor.speaker: Her
amber_corridor.line_1: Amber sacs hang under the wall skin like hard blisters. Each one has a dark vein tied into the corridor muscle.
amber_corridor.line_2: Cutting them gives biomass and may hurt. Sealing myself restores shield and adds corruption. Leaving them keeps the pressure intact.

amber_corridor.speaker: Her
amber_corridor.line_1: A flat amber plaque slides open at hand height. Inside, bead-sized organs pulse in rows like a wet abacus.
amber_corridor.line_2: Chorus, toll organ live. Paying biomass keeps the route quiet. Refusing or leaving lets it count me.

amber_corridor.speaker: Her
amber_corridor.line_1: A metal tool is trapped inside a waist-high amber clot. Bone has grown through the handle and locked it in place.
amber_corridor.line_2: Breaking the clot gives biomass and cuts me. Testing the shell may restore shield and lower danger. Leaving loses the cache.

amber_corridor.speaker: Her
amber_corridor.line_1: The amber in the walls turns cloudy and starts to soften. Drops fall from the ceiling and smoke on the floor.
amber_corridor.line_2: If I linger, this lane will set around me. I move before it hardens.

amber_corridor.speaker: Her
amber_corridor.line_1: Resin seams split along the floor. A blood hunter pulls free with amber stuck to its legs and proboscis.
amber_corridor.line_2: It is slowed, not stopped. Fighting can earn biomass; avoiding it leaves danger behind me.

amber_corridor.speaker: Her
amber_corridor.line_1: The amber wall stays sealed. Fluid moves inside it, but no seam opens.
amber_corridor.line_2: I take no biomass here. The pressure stays contained, and I leave less scent behind.

split_green_corridor.speaker: Her
split_green_corridor.line_1: The passage splits around a green support spine. The left branch is soft and warm; the right branch is dry shell over exposed cartilage.
split_green_corridor.line_2: Soft tissue can mend me and add corruption. Green spine can be cut for biomass and damage. Waiting lowers danger.

split_green_corridor.speaker: Her
split_green_corridor.line_1: Green spores drift ankle-high across both branch mouths. They collect in footprints and lift when the floor flexes.
split_green_corridor.line_2: Moving carefully lowers danger. Stirring the spores can heal me, but adds corruption and danger. Waiting gives a safer read.

split_green_corridor.speaker: Her
split_green_corridor.line_1: Chorus, airway control in the wall. A thumb-sized wheel connects to tubes running under the branch floor.
split_green_corridor.line_2: Turning the wheel lowers danger now, but repeated muting may be noticed. Breaking it gives biomass and damage. Leaving changes nothing.

split_green_corridor.speaker: Her
split_green_corridor.line_1: The spore cloud parts around a low moving shape. A spine stalker crawls forward, green dust packed between its plates.
split_green_corridor.line_2: Fighting can clear it for biomass. If I break sight and slip away, danger carries forward.

split_green_corridor.speaker: Her
split_green_corridor.line_1: The green branch holds its shape. Vines twitch in the ceiling, but none reach down.
split_green_corridor.line_2: No resource opens here. I keep moving before the branch reacts to my pace.

split_red_corridor.speaker: Her
split_red_corridor.line_1: The fork wraps around a swollen red artery. Beside it, a dry lane has cracked into sharp plates.
split_red_corridor.line_2: Opening the artery gives biomass and corruption. Forcing the dry lane costs health. Marking the branch lowers danger.

split_red_corridor.speaker: Her
split_red_corridor.line_1: Pressure builds behind both walls. The artery knots tight, and red fluid beads through the cracks.
split_red_corridor.line_2: Rushing costs health and raises danger. Venting gives biomass and lowers danger. Falling back gives up the gain.

split_red_corridor.speaker: Her
split_red_corridor.line_1: The artery bulges at shoulder height. A blood hunter peels off it wet, already turning toward my heat.
split_red_corridor.line_2: It has seen me. Fighting can earn biomass; avoiding it leaves danger behind me.

split_red_corridor.speaker: Her
split_red_corridor.line_1: The red fork steadies. The artery still pulses, but the cracked lane stops shifting underfoot.
split_red_corridor.line_2: No resource opens here. I leave before the split reacts again.

bone_corridor.speaker: Her
bone_corridor.line_1: Contact. A marrow sentinel blocks the lane, taller than me, built from rib struts and packed white tissue.
bone_corridor.line_2: It is guarding the bone cache behind it. If I want the cache, I have to cut it down.

bone_corridor.speaker: Her
bone_corridor.line_1: Bone piles fill the corridor waist-high. Human femurs, animal jaws, and curved plates are fused into one heap.
bone_corridor.line_2: Scavenging gives biomass and may hurt. Probing the heap lowers danger. Leaving it loses the cache.

bone_corridor.speaker: Her
bone_corridor.line_1: Chorus, pale footmarks glow across the bone floor. Each mark is exactly my stride length.
bone_corridor.line_2: Following lowers danger now, but repeated obedience may be noticed. Breaking the marks costs health and resets the pattern.

bone_corridor.speaker: Her
bone_corridor.line_1: Dry bone dust hangs in the air. Every step grinds powder from the floor and leaves white prints behind me.
bone_corridor.line_2: Nothing fresh moves here. I cross the old intake and leave the cache alone.

bone_corridor.speaker: Her
bone_corridor.line_1: Thin bone plates lift from the floor like teeth. Between them, small symbiotes cling to wet roots and click against the shell.
bone_corridor.line_2: Bonding gives one symbiote and kills the rest. Fighting wakes the ward. Leaving keeps my gait mine.

bone_corridor.speaker: Her
bone_corridor.line_1: A bone lathe turns in the wall, shaving the ridge into pale curls. A guard shape hangs dormant behind the mechanism.
bone_corridor.line_2: Stripping gives biomass. Probing lowers danger. Jamming the lathe wakes the guard.

bone_corridor.speaker: Her
bone_corridor.line_1: The shaft narrows until my shoulders brush both sides. Bone barbs angle inward and track the heat of my skin.
bone_corridor.line_2: Forcing through costs health. Fighting makes the contact direct. Withdrawing avoids the cut and raises danger.

spiked_red_corridor.speaker: Her
spiked_red_corridor.line_1: Chorus, red bone spikes push through the floor and wall in rows. The lane is closing from both sides.
spiked_red_corridor.line_2: Pushing through costs heavy health. Breaking a path costs less and gives biomass. Withdrawing leaves the pressure behind me.

spiked_red_corridor.speaker: Her
spiked_red_corridor.line_1: Spines cover the walls, but a low gap runs under them where the floor has not grown shut.
spiked_red_corridor.line_2: I crawl the narrow line and spend no extra blood.

organ_chamber_red.speaker: Her
organ_chamber_red.line_1: Visual on the chamber core. A heart the size of a furnace hangs from black cords, with the keeper planted beneath it.
organ_chamber_red.line_2: Fighting opens the chamber and risks injury. Circling avoids the keeper and leaves the room unresolved.

organ_chamber_red.speaker: Her
organ_chamber_red.line_1: The chamber pulse pushes air against my chest. My breathing starts to match it one beat at a time.
organ_chamber_red.line_2: Steady breathing lowers danger. Cutting cords gives biomass and corruption. Breaking away raises pursuit.

organ_chamber_red.speaker: Her
organ_chamber_red.line_1: The suspended core keeps beating. Small listening pits open around the walls with every pulse.
organ_chamber_red.line_2: I keep my breathing off the rhythm and leave before the room can count me.

healing_pool.speaker: Her
healing_pool.line_1: A clear pool fills a round pit in the floor. The surface smells sterile, and pale threads move under the water.
healing_pool.line_2: Drinking restores health and adds corruption. Studying lowers corruption. Retreat keeps my body unchanged.

healing_pool.speaker: Her
healing_pool.line_1: The pool surface dimples before I touch it. Something under the water turns toward my shadow.
healing_pool.line_2: Breaking the surface restores more health and adds corruption. Sampling lowers corruption. Leaving avoids the pool.

healing_pool.speaker: Her
healing_pool.line_1: The pool gives off a steady pale glow. No bubbles rise, and the threads below the surface stay still.
healing_pool.line_2: I pass without drinking and keep my body unchanged.

egg_corridor.speaker: Her
egg_corridor.line_1: Egg sacs line both sides of the corridor, packed tight from floor to ceiling. One sac is open and dripping clear fluid.
egg_corridor.line_2: Harvesting gives biomass and corruption. Burning a lane costs health. Slipping through gains nothing and keeps danger low.

egg_corridor.speaker: Her
egg_corridor.line_1: A cracked shell lies on the right with its inner skin peeled back. Wet drag marks lead into a side fold.
egg_corridor.line_2: Shell residue gives quiet biomass. Drag marks lead to more biomass and raise danger. Leaving loses the trail.

egg_corridor.speaker: Her
egg_corridor.line_1: One egg opens from the inside in four wet pieces. A small spine stalker stands in the yolk and spreads its legs.
egg_corridor.line_2: Killing it clears the nest for biomass. Slipping away avoids injury now and leaves danger behind me.

egg_corridor.speaker: Her
egg_corridor.line_1: The nest stays still. The sacs press against my shoulders as I pass, but none split.
egg_corridor.line_2: I keep my steps light. No shell breaks, and no scent blooms.

corruption_spike_room.speaker: Her
corruption_spike_room.line_1: Chorus, bone spikes are breaching through red tissue ahead. The points are still growing as I watch.
corruption_spike_room.line_2: If I push through, I pay for it in blood.

symbiote_host_offer.speaker: Her
symbiote_host_offer.line_1: Chorus, dying host ahead. Its armor is open, and several symbiotes are still clinging under the ribs.
symbiote_host_offer.line_2: One bond is possible. The shock kills the rest and makes the survivor dependent on me.

merchant_arrival.speaker: Her
merchant_arrival.line_1: Chorus, contact. The spider-bodied merchant waits in the crossing with six hands, a scale, and a sealed egg behind him.
merchant_arrival.line_2: No reply from Chorus. His prices are already set in wet weights.

danger_spike_notice.speaker: Her
danger_spike_notice.line_1: Chorus, my pulse is loud in the walls. Small pores open beside me and close after I pass.
danger_spike_notice.line_2: The organism is tracking my movement. Next contact will come faster.

director_corruption_warning.speaker: Her
director_corruption_warning.line_1: Chorus, the walls flex in time with my steps. The tissue near my hands opens before I touch it.
director_corruption_warning.line_2: The organism recognizes the altered tissue in me. Corruption is pulling harder.

director_dependence_warning.speaker: Her
director_dependence_warning.line_1: Chorus, the symbiote moves before I give it the signal. It tightens under my skin, ready for a command I did not finish.
director_dependence_warning.line_2: Useful. Bad sign. Dependence is learning my timing.

director_danger_warning.speaker: Her
director_danger_warning.line_1: Chorus, buzzing behind me. Same distance for three rooms. It stops when I stop.
director_danger_warning.line_2: Avoiding fights still leaves a trail. Danger is catching up.

director_greed_warning.speaker: Her
director_greed_warning.line_1: Chorus, biomass residue coats my gloves and tail blade. The vents open wider when I slow near a cache.
director_greed_warning.line_2: The organism knows what I stop to harvest. Greed is becoming route data.

director_safety_warning.speaker: Her
director_safety_warning.line_1: Chorus, the quiet routes are getting smaller. Side folds seal before I reach them.
director_safety_warning.line_2: The organism is pricing caution in lost access and longer paths.

director_combat_warning.speaker: Her
director_combat_warning.line_1: Chorus, dead things behind me are still warm. Fluids from each fight mark the floor in a line.
director_combat_warning.line_2: Killing through every room is still noise. The organism can follow it.

director_debt_warning.speaker: Her
director_debt_warning.line_1: Chorus, resin clicks behind me in pairs, like scale weights settling. No footsteps. Just accounting.
director_debt_warning.line_2: The merchant does not need to be in the room to keep a ledger. Refusal has a pulse.

smother_hunter_arrival.speaker: Her
smother_hunter_arrival.line_1: Air stops moving. The last quiet lane folds shut behind me, and a flat hunter drops from the ceiling like a wet blanket.
smother_hunter_arrival.line_2: Smother hunter. It learned the places I muted.

plate_snare.speaker: Her
plate_snare.line_1: Chorus, the plate line remembers my stride. Floor plates rise under my feet while wall plates close at hip height.
plate_snare.line_2: I followed too clean. Now it wants to pin the route to my bones.

hunter_reckoning.speaker: Her
hunter_reckoning.line_1: Chorus, the buzzing stops behind me. The blood hunter drops into the lane ahead, blocking the only open route.
hunter_reckoning.line_2: This is the bill for all that distance.

corruption_claim.speaker: Her
corruption_claim.line_1: Chorus, my hands open without asking me. The wall tissue opens with them, matching the shape of my fingers.
corruption_claim.line_2: Too much of this place fits me. I lose the boundary.

merchant_reckoning.speaker: Her
merchant_reckoning.line_1: Chorus, the corridor opens into the merchant's scale room. Side paths seal behind curtains of red muscle.
merchant_reckoning.line_2: I ran from him too often. Now he wants all of me on the scale.

floor_transition.speaker: Her
floor_transition.line_1: The floor drops into a lower layer. The air is colder, the walls are darker, and the pulse comes from below now.
floor_transition.line_2: I reset my breathing and keep moving.
